title: Tricky Pronunciation: To Eat Lotus Roots
synopsis: Find out what happens to David when he doesn’t take care to pronounce “eating lotus roots” correctly…

fullText.simplified:
难搞的汉语发音：吃藕

    大卫在中国的大学学汉语，他已经学了两年多了，因为他一直住在中国，天天用汉语交流，所以汉语水平提高得很快。但是大卫说话太快，不注意发音，有时候，连中国人都听不出来他说的是什么。
    有一次，他在大学食堂遇到了他喜欢的中国女同学。他走了过去，想找个话题跟女同学聊天。他看见女同学正在吃“藕”，就马上说：“小静，昨天听见你说吃藕，今天你真吃藕哦！”因为他说得太快，“吃藕”听起来像“丑”，这个叫小静的女同学一听就生气地说：“你才丑呢？”说完就端着饭去别的座位吃了。
    大卫一看小静生气了，很奇怪。他旁边的朋友笑着说：“大卫，平时让你多注意发音，你不听。你说的‘吃藕’听起来像‘丑’，哪个女人喜欢听别人说自己丑呀？”
fullText.traditional:
難搞的漢語發音：吃藕

    大衛在中國的大學學漢語，他已經學了兩年多了，因為他一直住在中國，天天用漢語交流，所以漢語水平提高得很快。但是大衛說話太快，不注意發音，有時候，連中國人都聽不出來他說的是什麼。
    有一次，他在大學食堂遇到了他喜歡的中國女同學。他走了過去，想找個話題跟女同學聊天。他看見女同學正在吃“藕”，就馬上說：“小靜，昨天聽見你說吃藕，今天你真吃藕哦！”因為他說得太快，“吃藕”聽起來像“醜”，這個叫小靜的女同學一聽就生氣地說：“你才醜呢？”說完就端著飯去別的座位吃了。
    大衛一看小靜生氣了，很奇怪。他旁邊的朋友笑著說：“大衛，平時讓你多注意發音，你不聽。你說的‘吃藕’聽起來像‘醜’，哪個女人喜歡聽別人說自己醜呀？”

raw.synopsis: Find out what happens to David when he doesn’t take care to pronounce “eating lotus roots” correctly…
sentence_translations: Tricky Chinese Pronunciation: To Eat Lotus Roots
David studies Chinese at a university in China. He’s already been studying it for more than two years.
Because he has continuously lived in China and uses Chinese daily to communicate, his Chinese proficiency has been improving quickly.
But David speaks too fast and doesn’t pay much attention to pronunciation. Sometimes, even Chinese people can’t discern what he says.
One time, at the university cafeteria, he encountered the female Chinese classmate that he likes.
He went over to her and tried to come up with a topic to chat to her about.
He saw that the girl was in the middle of eating lotus roots, so he immediately said, ..
.. “Little Jing, yesterday I heard you talking about eating lotus roots. Today you’re eating lotus roots for real!”
Because he spoke too quickly, “eating lotus roots” sounded just like the word “ugly”.
As soon as this female classmate called Little Jing heard this, she angrily said: “You are the ugly one!”
After saying this, she took her food and moved to eat at another seat.
As soon as David saw that Little Jing got angry, he was very baffled.
His friend beside him laughed and said, ..
.. “David, I always ask you to pay more attention to your pronunciation, but you never listen.
Your ‘eating lotus roots’ sounded just like the word ‘ugly’. What kind of woman likes to hear others say that she is ugly?”
